interface.result: AttemptTransition accepted true retains identical state and optional CorrectionFeedback
interface.feedback: kind correction-learning; correct/wrong with RawMarks OR incomplete/unrecognized with MarkingIssue[]; score/timing/independent forbidden
interface.scope: Assessed automatic parts only, including reveal and mixed aggregates; no repeat rubric/drawing judgement
interface.persistence: Ephemeral transition result only; no StudentAttempt, repository schema or evidence changes
interface.host: Forward result to player; return before save/scheduler; clear feedback on response edits/adopt/identity
interface.foremanApproval: Ephemeral boundary approved; foreman coordinates A04 host/player and confirms no A05 changes required

validation.browser: Foreman/A04 own integrated correction browser acceptance; this bounded fix makes no browser completion claim
validation.retainedOriginalEvidence: Original validation/s1/attempt/handover.json, tests.txt and browser-results.json remain unchanged; prior background observation issue is not overwritten

verifiedInvariants: Wrong first result followed by corrected current answer produces correct learning feedback; repeat Checks retain identical state and first evidence/time/score.
Reveal produces incomplete/correct learning feedback without a first score or independent evidence.
Blank/malformed numeric input prechecks before marking; unknown text remains unrecognized with source policy rubric support; recognized wrong stays wrong.
Mixed explanation and drawing aggregates only recheck automatic parts and retain original review decisions and marks.
Learning Check never calls masteryScore and has no persisted state field.
Answering/pending-review/self-only attempts cannot create correction marks.
scope: S1 only; no UI, persistence, host, timing runtime, package, original app or S2 edits
